title: Arcane Wilds Weighted Combo Rules Configuration
description: Defines weighted cross-element, single-element, custom spell, and Ancient Magicks combo chains for Arcane Wilds.

$schema.description: Path to the JSON Schema for editor validation and autocomplete.

format.description: Optional format identifier used on exported JSON files.

modVersion.description: Optional Arcane Wilds mod version that generated this file.

exportedAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp when exported from the editor.

rules.description: List of weighted combo rules. Stage 1 determines which equipped element or starting spell triggers each rule.

ComboStage.description: One stage in a combo chain (casts one or more spells at the given speed multiplier).

category.description: Element/weapon category (e.g. 'Air', 'Fire', 'Water', 'Earth', 'Air_Wand', 'AncientMagicks', or a custom spell name). Optional when 'spell' names a custom/global spell directly.

spells.description: Ordered list of spell names from spell_names.txt, custom_spells.json, or DA_Spell_* asset names.

spell.description: Shorthand for a single-spell stage (equivalent to spells: [spell]).

speed.description: Animation playback speed multiplier for this stage (e.g. 2.2 = 2.2x).

id.description: Optional stable identifier (used on mod default rules so players can disable them individually across updates).

name.description: Optional friendly label shown in debug logs.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable this combo rule without deleting it.

weight.description: Relative roll weight when multiple enabled rules match the same starting element.

chain.description: Optional compact shorthand alternative to 'stages', e.g. 'Fire@bolt_1,bolt_2:2.2 -> Air@gust,vortex:2.2'.
